# Godot / GDScript Gotchas

> Known Godot 4 and GDScript patterns that cause crashes, silent failures, or hard-to-debug rendering issues. Load all HIGH entries before writing any .tscn or .gd file.

## Entries

- [Projectiles must be children of a container node](projectile-parent.md): Adding projectiles as children of the player causes them to inherit the player's transform and move with it. Use a sibling container node. HIGH.
- [Sub-resource IDs in .tscn must be unique strings](sub-resource-ids.md): Duplicate sub-resource IDs cause silent resource conflicts. Godot uses format like "RectangleShape2D_abc12". HIGH.
- [Preload paths must match exact file locations](preload-paths.md): preload() crashes at parse time if the path doesn't exist. All referenced scenes must exist before any script that preloads them. HIGH.
- [collision_layer vs collision_mask](collision-layers.md): collision_layer = what I am; collision_mask = what I detect. Setting both to the same value causes objects to scan for themselves. HIGH.
- [CanvasModulate must be near-black not pure black](canvasmodulate.md): Pure black (0,0,0) makes PointLight2D invisible. Use (0.02, 0.02, 0.04). PointLight2D also requires a CanvasModulate node to have any visible effect. HIGH.
- [Timer callbacks can outlive their source node](timer-callbacks.md): SceneTree timers outlive the node that created them. Check is_instance_valid(self) at the start of every timer callback. HIGH.
- [@onready var paths must match .tscn node names exactly](onready-paths.md): Mismatched node names fail silently at runtime. HIGH.
- [:= type inference fails through base-class-typed variables](type-inference.md): Use explicit type annotation (var x: float =) instead of := when accessing script-defined properties through a base-class-typed variable. MEDIUM.
- [No class_name on autoload scripts](no-class-name-autoload.md): Autoloads are accessed by node name. Adding class_name causes naming conflicts. MEDIUM.
- [Area2D body_entered vs area_entered detect different node types](area2d-signals.md): body_entered detects PhysicsBody2D nodes. area_entered detects other Area2D nodes. Using the wrong signal silently fails. MEDIUM.
- [project.godot input map serialization is fragile](input-map-serialization.md): Hand-written InputEventKey variant encoding is error-prone. Use the Godot editor or fall back to Input.is_key_pressed. MEDIUM.
- [PowerShell does not wait for Godot's windowed exe on Windows, so a headless check run there tests nothing](powershell-does-not-wait-for-godot-s-windowed-exe-on-windows-so-a-headless-check.md): On Windows, PowerShell returns immediately from Godot's windowed exe (`Godot_v4.x-stable_win64.exe`) with no output and an empty `$LASTEXITCODE`, so a headless test or smoke check run that way… HIGH.
- [A project.godot not made by the New Project dialog runs Godot Physics, not Jolt, because DEFAULT still means GodotPhysics3D](a-project-godot-not-made-by-the-new-project-dialog-runs-godot-physics-not-jolt.md): In Godot 4.6+ (verified 4.7.2), `physics/3d/physics_engine` defaults to `DEFAULT`, and `DEFAULT` runs Godot Physics, not Jolt. HIGH.
- [GUT skips a test file that fails to compile and still prints "All tests passed!" with exit 0](gut-skips-a-test-file-that-fails-to-compile-and-still-prints-all-tests-passed.md): When a GUT test script fails to compile (a parse error, a strict-typing warning treated as error, or a missing dependency), GUT 9.7.1 on Godot 4.7.2 logs it as `[GUT WARNING]: Ignoring script ...… HIGH.
- [Godot exports every .json file as a resource, so stray config JSON ships inside the PCK](godot-exports-every-json-file-as-a-resource-so-stray-config-json-ships-inside.md): Godot 4 treats `.json` as a resource type, so an `all_resources` export bundles every JSON file in the project, including tool config like `.gutconfig.json`, into the PCK. HIGH.
- [An exported Godot dedicated server dies on SIGTERM (exit 143) and loses buffered stdout](an-exported-godot-dedicated-server-dies-on-sigterm-exit-143-and-loses-buffered.md): Godot installs no SIGTERM handler, so an exported Linux server is killed outright (exit 143) and its stdout, buffered when redirected to a file or pipe, is discarded. HIGH.
- [In a -s SceneTree script, root is not in the tree during _initialize, so HTTPRequest fails with ERR_UNCONFIGURED](in-a-s-scenetree-script-root-is-not-in-the-tree-during-initialize-so-httprequest.md): Nodes added to `root` inside `_initialize()` of a `godot -s` script are not yet inside the tree, so an HTTPRequest there fails every request with `ERR_UNCONFIGURED`. HIGH.
- [Control.set_anchors_preset keeps the current position; use set_anchors_and_offsets_preset to fill the parent](control-set-anchors-preset-keeps-the-current-position-use-set-anchors-and.md): `set_anchors_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)` on a code-built Control recomputes offsets to keep its current rect, so the control stays at its minimum size in the top-left corner. HIGH.
- [Opening a FileAccess.open_encrypted file with the wrong key prints an engine ERROR that fails GUT tests](opening-a-fileaccess-open-encrypted-file-with-the-wrong-key-prints-an-engine.md): Decrypting an `open_encrypted` file with the wrong key prints an engine `ERROR:` (MD5 mismatch) before returning null, and GUT 9.7 fails any test that prints an engine error. MEDIUM.
- [FileAccess.open_encrypted_with_pass keys AES-256 on an MD5 hex string](fileaccess-open-encrypted-with-pass-keys-aes-256-on-an-md5-hex-string.md): `open_encrypted_with_pass` uses `pass.md5_text()` (32 hex characters) as the AES-256 key, so the key has only 128 bits of material whatever passphrase you supply. HIGH.
